messages:
jamal: Quick question — where do I look for per-pool autoscale snapshots? Need CPU / KV cache saturation + recent scale events for eu-west-dedicated-3. Anyone have dashboard links or saved queries?

maria: We have a saved Grafana folder: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/infra/dedicated-pools?orgId=1. Look for the panels "Pool Autoscale Events" and "KV cache hit rate by pool". :point_down:

maria: Example PromQL to see pod CPU and queue depth over the last hour:
```
sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{pool="eu-west-dedicated-3"}[1m])) by (instance)
sum(series_queue_length{pool="eu-west-dedicated-3"})
```

alex: For traces and scale events check Honeycomb: https://ui.honeycomb.io/redwood/datasets/serving/traces. Filter: dataset=serving pool=eu-west-dedicated-3 service=autoscaler

priya: If you want the raw scale event log, use infractl:
```
infractl events list --pool eu-west-dedicated-3 --since 2h --type scale
```
That prints timestamp + reason + target_replicas.

ops-bot: Alert triggered: dedicated-pool-saturation (eu-west-dedicated-3) at 2026-04-17T12:08:09Z — queue_depth 78% — suppressed for 3m

alex: Happy to if you want me to relax the alert to 85% for 5m. Current rule is queue_depth > 70% for 2m which is noisy during rolling deploys.

jamal: Yes please, can you open a quick PR to bump to 85% and 5m? I'll add a note to the rollout checklist to watch for KV cache warmup.

alex: Will do. PR link when ready.

priya: Also suggest adding a derived metric "kv_effective_capacity" = kv_hit_rate * instance_count to avoid false saturation when cache is cold.

maria: Good idea. We already have a saved query for kv_hit_rate, I'll add the derived metric to the pool dashboard and pin it.

jamal: Thanks all. I'll capture the links and paste into the incident channel if it recurs. :thumbsup:
